verification_note: Structure checked against the LankaLaw HTML it was parsed from; wording spot-checked against the 1961 as-enacted print as described in checked_against. Act No. 16 of 2019 applied by hand from its Government Printer text layer (see applied_amendments). Not read word for word throughout. Legal effect is not verified.
quality_notes: Section 31: omitted from the LankaLaw HTML without any marker or note; present in the 1961 print. See omitted_provisions. The validator's numbering-gap warning on 31 is this.
Sections 46 and 47: omitted by the publisher as repealing and amending provisions (footnote on the page, see omitted_provisions). The validator's numbering-gap warning on 46-47 is this.

Section 29D: the HTML reads 'in section 291' where the context (the roman-lettered series 29A-29T) suggests 29L; kept as held, and the validator's 'internal section 291 beyond last section' warning is this typo. The Government Printer scan page carrying 29D was not read.

Section 4: the parser kept the run 'The purposes of the Bank shall be (1) to develop and assist (a) the Co-operative Movement of Sri Lanka;' on the section and again on subsection (1), and hung paragraphs (b)-(d) under it, because the LankaLaw page prints the substituted section (from 32 of 1986) inline without its enumerator markup. The wording is complete; the depth of (1)(a) is a parser convention. The validator's 'repeats first child' warning on 4 is this.
Section 29L: the section text repeats the opening of paragraph (a) for the same reason; wording complete. The validator's 'repeats first child' warning on 29L is this.

Section 29A: HTML heading 'Action by Board here default is made.' corrected to 'Action by Board where default is made.' from the marginal note on page 9 of the 32 of 1986 Government Printer scan; HTML reading kept in heading_raw.
Section 41: the heading carried the unparsed marker '[57(1), 18 of 1965]'; moved to amendment_events, heading kept in heading_raw. It is the only trace in the HTML of Act No. 18 of 1965.

Section 20: heading replaced with the marginal note of the substituted section in Act No. 16 of 2019; the HTML heading ('The Bank to raise money the issue of debentures ...', missing 'by') kept in heading_raw.
Section 34(6): differs from the 1961 print with no marker on the HTML (see checked_against). Which instrument changed it is not known from held sources; unresolved.

Sections 8 and 10 carry markers '[ 3, Law 25 of 1978]' and section 8 also '[ 2, 61 of 1980]'; Law No. 25 of 1978 is not held. The 61 of 1980 Act names it as the People's Bank (Special Provisions) Law, No. 25 of 1978.

Chain header lists 'Gazette Nos, 1386-18-2005'; no marker in the body refers to it. It is presumably an Order under section 12(2) determining paid-up capital; not held, and section 12 has since been replaced by 16 of 2019.

Acts Nos. 11 of 1963, 16 of 1969 and Law No. 43 of 1973 are in the chain header but leave no marker in the body. The held HTML of 16 of 1969 (section 90(2)) and of 43 of 1973 both amend section 5(1)(a) of this Act; section 5 was wholly replaced by 32 of 1986, so their effect is spent.

Act No. 16 of 2019 postdates the HTML's chain and was applied by hand from the Government Printer text layer: section 12 and section 20 replaced, 21(1)(b), 21(3) and 43(2)(c) repealed (nodes kept with empty text, prior wording in pre_amendment_text). Each operation is listed in applied_amendments with the pre-amendment wording.

Commencement: the head date printed on the page is 30th May, 1961; statute_commencement.csv gives 1980-01-01 and links the 2019 amending Act's page. The head date is used; the CSV value is kept in commencement_csv_value.

Section count: statute-section-index holds 72 entries for SRC080 = the 64 LankaLaw sections plus 8 legacy entries ('0', '46', '47', '59', '60', '61', '62', '84') scraped from the Central Bank appendix, of which 59-62 and 84 belong to other enactments printed in the same appendix and '0' is a page marker. The HTML has 64 sections; the 1961 print has 47 in the extract (2-48). This tree has 64.
curriculum_discrepancy: The curriculum cites 'People's Bank Act No. 43 of 1973' (registry note). Law No. 43 of 1973 in the chain header is the Sale of State Lands (Special Provisions) Law (held HTML title), which amends section 5(1)(a) of this Act. The principal Act is No. 29 of 1961.
